text:
Maya Patel (AE): quick sync — Pegasus Health execs asked for an end-to-end presales update. they want a single-thread point person. I can run the bridge if needed but want clear asks first.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): happy to own tech deep-dive. main open items from my side: dedicated fleet sizing, mixed GPU support (A10 + H100 fallback), and websocket throughput SLO.
Maya Patel (AE): CX wants 5k concurrent streams and 99th pct < 200ms for generation path. also want BYO-HSM timeline and attestation doc.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): noted. to validate throughput we'll run a short harness — can we get an internal burst quota for the trial? need ~24h of elevated capacity.
Claire Nguyen (VP Sales): +1 to giving SE the quota. finance will need an MRC vs usage proposal. Maya, can you share expected annual committed spend range?
Maya Patel (AE): they signalled ~$450k ARR if POC passes. want a 90-day trial window before commit.
Rajiv Menon (Customer Success): onboarding plan: 2-week config, 4-week POC with ops runbook. needs an allowlist + IP peering checklist. I can prep the runbook.
Priya Sinha (Security): security blockers: Pegasus asked for HSM attestation, EU+CA data residency confirmation, and our SIG questionnaire answers. we also need an answer on key rotation policy for BYO-HSM.
Dan Keller (Legal): also asked about logging retention for audits and liability around customer-managed keys. I'll draft an addendum but need exact KMS/HSM vendor list from customer.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): to unblock: 1) elevated quota for 24h test, 2) internal note on mixed-GPU latency variance, 3) BYO-HSM runbook + sample timeline (we can do 2–3 weeks for integration), 4) sample config for websocket stress test.
Maya Patel (AE): pegasus legal will share vendor list tomorrow. can we get the quota before that? they'd like to smoke-test inference patterns today.
Claire Nguyen (VP Sales): approve temporary quota for testing only, SE to coordinate with eng-infra. keep it timeboxed and non-billable.
deploy-bot: quota-change request #Q-4821 created by Claire Nguyen — requested: 24h elevated GPU burst for se/pegasus-poc. ETA approval: 30m.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): I'll coordinate with eng-infra. @Priya — can you confirm if we can provide an attestation template, or do you want Pegasus to provide specific HSM certs?
Priya Sinha (Security): we provide a vendor-agnostic attestation template. for BYO-HSM we need: vendor certs, attestation of FIPS/CC level, and rotation schedule. send template to customer with request list.
Dan Keller (Legal): FYI — addendum will include: indemnity carveout for BYO-HSM misconfiguration, logging SLA, and data residency clause. I'll circulate a redline by EOD.
Rajiv Menon (Customer Success): runbook checklist draft below (I pasted to speed things up):
```
- Pre-POC: allowlist IPs, confirm egress paths, provide SSH bastion for debug
- Integration week: deploy test model to dedicated pool, enable prefix caching, run 24h stress harness
- POC success: 99p token latency <200ms, sustained 5k concurrent ws connections, no TLS errors >0.1%
```
Mateo Ruiz (SE): thanks Rajiv — here's the harness curl sample I'll use for throughput (short):
```
for i in {1..2000}; do \
  curl -s -N \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":64}' \
    https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
  sleep 0.01
done
```
Maya Patel (AE): perfect. Mateo — pls ping eng-infra channel for the quota and post the approval here.
deploy-bot: quota-change #Q-4821 approved by eng-infra-lead — window scheduled: 2025-11-12T16:00Z to 2025-11-13T16:00Z.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): quota live. starting smoke tests now. posting results in ~1h.
Priya Sinha (Security): sending attestation template to Pegasus security now. cc: Dan, Maya.
Claire Nguyen (VP Sales): one more ask — if POC passes, are we comfortable offering a 90-day conversion with a 20% ramp credit? finance, flag any concerns.
Dan Keller (Legal): will review commercial template with the credit language. may need exec signoff depending on total exposure.
Maya Patel (AE): noted. will capture all action items and run an executive sync tomorrow morning with Pegasus (they asked for a 30-min bridge).
Rajiv Menon (Customer Success): I'll own onboarding checklist and the post-test remediation plan.
Mateo Ruiz (SE): smoke test summary: 2h in — sustained 4.8k ws streams, 99p latency ~210ms with A10 primary + H100 fallback spikes. collecting traces now to tune batching.
Maya Patel (AE): thanks — keep me posted. if we can shave 10–15ms on 99p we're solid for CX.
Priya Sinha (Security): received vendor list from Pegasus. starting HSM validation.
Dan Keller (Legal): drafting addendum, will share in thread when ready.
Claire Nguyen (VP Sales): thanks team — looks good. Maya, capture exec bridge invite and confirm attendees. :thumbsup:
